ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (dark) contiguous banding along the entire peripheral trailing edge; multiple vertical low-intensity streaks originating at the trailing edge and extending toward the base; a distinct dark focal spot located at the distal region of the left lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 48 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 1/6th the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (3-15 pixels) forming a jagged profile along the entire length of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins, tapering into sharp, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters localized near the trailing edge margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, vertically-oriented dark linear pixel disruptions (rake-like patterns) prominent on the central-right portion of the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and missing segments along the trailing edge, particularly visible on the left-central margin and distal tips, suggesting previous mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'dripping' morphology of pigmentation streaks extending from the trailing edge serrations toward the center of the fluke lobes.
